findings.title: Customer can access another customer's invoice
findings.expected_behavior: Only the owning customer or an explicitly authorized role can read the invoice.
findings.observed_behavior: In this fictional example, Customer A received Customer B's synthetic invoice.

evidence.description: Illustrative placeholder for redacted request/response and independent ownership controls.

reproduction_steps: Establish the synthetic record belongs to Customer B and confirm the owner's access.
Request the same record using Customer A's test session.
Compare the returned record with the independent ownership assertion.
findings.recommendation: Enforce invoice ownership on the server using the authenticated identity. Retest both cross-account denial and legitimate owner access.
limitations: Fictional example, not a discovered vulnerability.
